Charity

LXII. William Warner

W
HO
 may, but will not helpe, doth hurt,
We know; and curious they,
That dribling arms by art disband,
Wel-meant from wel-done pay:
And he that questions distresse,
And doth not help endevour,
Then he that sees, and nothing saies
Or cares, is less deceavour.
